verdict.rationale: Grok docs mention 'Grok Bot' operating on a 'persistent cloud computer' (grok-docs-15) and connectors that let Grok reach email/files/calendar (grok-docs-11), showing some agentic task-automation capability, but this is a cloud sandbox, not the user's own local machine with visual application control (no computer-use/screen-operation feature documented). Community feedback also raises doubts about Grok's agentic tool-calling reliability (grok-comm-6). Missing for 10: evidence of controlling/seeing the user's actual desktop applications, screenshot-based navigation, or an 'operator'-style local computer-use mode, and independent hands-on verification of Grok Bot performing real desktop tasks.
